explanation: I searched Mathlib for other statements of the form `LinearIndependent K fun σ : Gal(L/K) ↦ σ x`, and for other normal basis results. The only matches are in the same file, `NormalBasis.lean`. Of those, `exists_linearIndependent_algEquiv_apply_of_infinite` covers only infinite K. `exists_linearIndependent_algEquiv_apply` is the general statement. It would imply the target, but its proof calls the target in the finite case, so it is circular. The remaining hits for "normalBasis" are unrelated orthonormal-basis results. I found no independent duplicate.
